question: What well-established Vedic method and which mantras are to be declared in detail?
premises: A well-established Vedic method is identified as the object of declaration.
The speaker commits to declaring that method.
Mantras are also to be declared, especially in detail.
inference: The text announces an exposition that will set forth a well-established Vedic method and give special attention to the relevant mantras.
uncertainties: The surface kraga is nonstandard and may represent kara within a compound.
The surface prasīddhitaṃ shows nonstandard spelling, possibly for prasiddhitam.
The form maṃtrāṃ is morphologically ambiguous in number/case as given.
plain_english: With joy, I shall declare that well-established Vedic method, and indeed the mantras, in detail.
